title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this first face, draw a circle with a center at coordinates [0.0082, 0.0082] and a radius of 0.0082 units. Move to the second face and draw another circle with the same radius but centered at [0.0082, 0.1007]. After completing the circles, apply a scaling factor of 0.1089 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction. Do not extrude in the opposite direction. This extrusion will generate a new solid body with a length of 0.016438356164383564 units, a width of 0.10890410958904112 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(0.0082)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical rod
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Define the second sketch
sketch_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0082, 0.1007).circle(0.0082)

# Extrude the second sketch to create another cylindrical rod
cylinder_2 = sketch_2.extrude(0.75)

# Combine the two cylinders
r = cylinder.union(cylinder_2)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first circle
circle_1 = workplane.center(0.0082, 0.0082).circle(0.0082)

# Create the second circle
circle_2 = workplane.center(0.0082, 0.1007).circle(0.0082)

# Combine the circles into a single sketch
sketch = circle_1.add(circle_2)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the sketch scale (if necessary)
# Note: The sketch scale is applied to the sketch before extrusion, but in this case, it's 0.0164 which is not applied to the final dimensions.
# If the scale was meant to be applied to the final dimensions, it would be done after extrusion.

# The final model
r = extrusion

# Create the first part
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0082, 0.0082)
    .circle(0.0082)
    .extrude(0.75)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0925, 0.0))
)

# Create the second part
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0082, 0.0082)
    .circle(0.0082)
    .extrude(0.75)
    .translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions
diameter = 0.0164
radius = diameter / 2.0
height = 0.75
y_spacing = 0.1089 - diameter  # center-to-center distance along Y

# Cylinder 1
cyl1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(radius, radius)
    .circle(radius)
    .extrude(height)
)

# Cylinder 2
cyl2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(radius, radius + y_spacing)
    .circle(radius)
    .extrude(height)
)

# Combine into a single part
r = cyl1.union(cyl2)
